6 of 6 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
Labor Relations Update — Collective Bargaining Status

The committee discussed the Labor Relations Update — Collective Bargaining Status, a review of the company's compliance with environmental laws. The committee reviewed the company's environmental impact and confirmed that it was in compliance.

Item 2
Severance Policy Amendment — Review and Vote

The committee reviewed the Severance Policy Amendment — Review and Vote materials circulated in advance of the meeting. Zainab Okorie was available to respond to questions. No substantive issues were raised. The committee accepted the report as presented. The responsible owner was directed to implement the recommended approach effective as of the due date.

Motion

To consent: RESOLVED, that the Sustainability Council adopts the revised Severance Policy Amendment — Review and Vote policy, which shall supersede all prior policies on this matter, effective immediately.

Moved: Hamish Miranda  •  Seconded: Natalie Singh
Vote: 6 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 3
Treasury Report: Cash Position and Investment Policy

The committee considered the Treasury Report: Cash Position and Investment Policy, a proposal to adopt a new policy on the use of social media by employees. The policy was approved and will be included in the employee handbook.

Motion

To approve for development: RESOLVED, that the Sustainability Council approves the minutes of the meeting held on 2025-10-08 as drafted and circulated.

Moved: Dat Uthaiwan  •  Seconded: Khaled Schäfer
Vote: 4 Yea  /  1 Nay  /  1 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 4
Annual Incentive Plan Performance Assessment

The Annual Incentive Plan Performance Assessment was a review of the company's compliance with the WARN Act in a recent layoff. The committee confirmed that all legal requirements had been met.
